summary: Promoted Fathom list shortcuts must read resource collections from the local store when --data-source local is selected.
reason: The meetings, teams, and team-members shortcuts are list endpoints. Treating them as single-object reads makes local mode look for an item whose ID is the endpoint name, so synced data appears missing.
validated_outcome: A temp synced SQLite store can satisfy meetings, teams, and team-members with --agent --data-source local.
